lines.say: Your flashcard deck has hundreds of cards, and you only ever revise the easy ones.
The hard ones sit at the bottom, until the exam.
Spreading reviews out beats cramming them. It's called spacing, and the research on it goes back over a century.
Offload builds your flashcards from your notes, and brings each one back right before you'd forget it.
Get one wrong, and it comes back sooner.
Offload. A study system that adapts when real life happens.
